Hexavest Inc decreased its stake in Pfizer Inc En (PFE) by 12.55% based on its latest 2018Q2 regulatory filing with the SEC. Hexavest Inc sold 858,294 shares as the company’s stock rose 17.09% with the market. The hedge fund held 5.98 million shares of the health care company at the end of 2018Q2, valued at $216.91 million, down from 6.84 million at the end of the previous reported quarter. Hexavest Inc who had been investing in Pfizer Inc En for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $251.33B market cap company. The stock increased 1.09% or $0.464 during the last trading session, reaching $42.874. About 8.18 million shares traded. Pfizer Inc. (NYSE:PFE) has risen 19.90% since September 13, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 4.28% the S&P500.
Hexavest Inc, which manages about $16.29 billion and $7.74B US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Aflac Inc (NYSE:AFL) by 1.08M shares to 1.08M shares, valued at $46.51M in 2018Q2, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in Sun Life Fncl Inc Co L En (NYSE:SLF) by 90,969 shares in the quarter, for a total of 489,435 shares, and has risen its stake in Apple Inc Gmt (NASDAQ:AAPL).
Analysts await Pfizer Inc. (NYSE:PFE) to report earnings on October, 30. They expect $0.75 EPS, up 11.94 % or $0.08 from last year’s $0.67 per share. PFE’s profit will be $4.40B for 14.29 P/E if the $0.75 EPS becomes a reality. After $0.81 actual EPS reported by Pfizer Inc. for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts -7.41 % negative EPS growth.
